messages.author: 6b30cf0383de9503
messages.subject: error extracting package from github on deployApp( )
parts:
the relevant error output when trying to deploy my app:


[2015-02-14T04:31:41.418417102+0000] Building R package: rrdflibs (1.3.3)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
Warning in untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  skipping pax global extended headers
ERROR: cannot extract package from ‘egonw-rrdf-7672a54.tar.gz’
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 7912086 failed: Error building image: Error building rrdflibs (1.3.3). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


I can't tell if this is something with the rrdf package or shiny's attempt to build.  I am able to install the rrdf package and run my app locally with no problems.  Any ideas would be appreciated

messages.subject: Re: error extracting package from github on deployApp( )
parts:
Hi,

This is an outstanding bug where the subdir parameter is not supported when installing packages on shinyapps.io.

However the good news is I worked up a fix this morning, so we should have that out by early next week.

-Andy

messages.subject: Re: error extracting package from github on deployApp( )

My problem was that the package folder was a subfolder of the github repo.
I moved it all up to the root of the repo,
and this problem went away.
